reason: My phone already rings from Google Maps and the Facebook page, and my daughter handles Instagram. Six hundred euros for a website when the guests already find me is money I would rather keep for the van.
objection: I do not see that a website brings me one extra transfer that Google Maps and WhatsApp do not already bring, and if I really wanted one my nephew could do it on Wix for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another taxi or transfer guy here on the coast show me in numbers that he got more bookings from his site in one season than it cost, or paying only when the first bookings come through.
